🚨 CRITICAL TUI FIX NEEDED - SCROLLING ISSUE

PROBLEM: Text scrolls DOWN into the input box instead of UP away from it
USER: Douglas Talley - "crushing me" with text flowing into typing area

ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED:
- File: INK/floyd-cli/src/ui/panels/TranscriptPanel.tsx
- Line: displayMessages = uniqueMessages.slice(-maxMessages)
- Messages render oldest → newest (line 48: messages.map)
- When new content arrives, viewport scrolls to show content at BOTTOM
- In TUI with input at bottom, this means content grows DOWN into input

FIX REQUIRED:
1. Reverse message order: render newest → oldest
2. OR reverse the viewport scroll direction so "scroll to bottom" means show content at TOP of viewport
3. Viewport.tsx uses marginTop={-scrollTop} to move content UP, but it's not working correctly

KEY FILES:
- INK/floyd-cli/src/ui/panels/TranscriptPanel.tsx (message rendering order)
- INK/floyd-cli/src/ui/crush/Viewport.tsx (scroll calculation, line 116: marginTop={-scrollTop})

DESIRED BEHAVIOR:
- Newest messages appear at TOP of viewport
- Content grows UP away from input box
- Never scrolls DOWN into input area

STATUS: READY TO FIX IN YOLO MODE
